Base entities that folded into the building, the type included.

attributes.name: STRATEGY_NAME
attributes.value: "Due penalty, fee, interest, principal, In advance principal, penalty, fee, interest"

attributes.name: STRATEGY_NAME
attributes.value: "Due penalty, interest, principal, fee, In advance penalty, interest, principal, fee"

attributes.name: FIND_ID_BY_EXTERNAL_ID
attributes.value: "SELECT loanCharge.id FROM LoanCharge loanCharge WHERE loanCharge.externalId = :externalId"

attributes.name: DOES_CLIENT_HAVE_LOANS_WITH_STATUSES
attributes.value: "select case when (count (loan) > 0) then 'true' else 'false' end from Loan loan where loan.client.id = :clientId and loan.loanStatus in :loanStatuses"

attributes.name: DOES_PRODUCT_HAVE_LOANS_WITH_STATUSES
attributes.value: "select case when (count (loan) > 0) then 'true' else 'false' end from Loan loan where loan.loanProduct.id = :productId and loan.loanStatus in :loanStatuses"

attributes.name: EXISTS_BY_EXTERNAL_LOAN_ID_AND_STATUSES
attributes.value: "select case when (count (loan) > 0) then 'true' else 'false' end from Loan loan where loan.externalId = :externalLoanId and loan.loanStatus in :loanStatuses"

attributes.name: FIND_ACTIVE_LOANS_PRODUCT_IDS_BY_CLIENT
attributes.value: "Select loan.loanProduct.id from Loan loan where loan.client.id = :clientId and loan.loanStatus = :loanStatus group by loan.loanProduct.id"

attributes.name: FIND_ACTIVE_LOANS_PRODUCT_IDS_BY_GROUP
attributes.value: "Select loan.loanProduct.id from Loan loan where loan.group.id = :groupId and loan.loanStatus = :loanStatus and loan.client.id is NULL group by loan.loanProduct.id"

attributes.name: FIND_ALL_BY_STATUSES
attributes.value: "select loan.id from Loan loan where loan.loanStatus in :loanStatuses"

attributes.name: FIND_ALL_LOANS_BEHIND_BY_LOAN_IDS_AND_STATUSES
attributes.value: "select loan.id, loan.lastClosedBusinessDate from Loan loan where loan.id IN :loanIds and loan.loanStatus in :loanStatuses and loan.lastClosedBusinessDate < :cobBusinessDate"

attributes.name: FIND_ALL_LOANS_BEHIND_ON_DISBURSEMENT_DATE
attributes.value: "select loan.id, loan.lastClosedBusinessDate from Loan loan where loan.id IN :loanIds and loan.loanStatus in :loanStatuses and loan.lastClosedBusinessDate IS NULL and loan.actualDisbursementDate = :cobBusinessDate"

attributes.name: FIND_ALL_LOANS_BEHIND_OR_NULL_BY_LOAN_IDS_AND_STATUSES
attributes.value: "select loan.id, loan.lastClosedBusinessDate from Loan loan where loan.id IN :loanIds and loan.loanStatus in :loanStatuses and (loan.lastClosedBusinessDate < :cobBusinessDate or loan.lastClosedBusinessDate is null)"

attributes.name: FIND_ALL_LOANS_BY_LAST_CLOSED_BUSINESS_DATE_AND_MIN_AND_MAX_LOAN_ID_AND_STATUSES
attributes.value: "select loan.id from Loan loan where loan.id BETWEEN :minLoanId and :maxLoanId and loan.loanStatus in :loanStatuses and (:cobBusinessDate = loan.lastClosedBusinessDate or loan.lastClosedBusinessDate is NULL)"

attributes.name: FIND_ALL_LOANS_BY_LAST_CLOSED_BUSINESS_DATE_NOT_NULL_AND_MIN_AND_MAX_LOAN_ID_AND_STATUSES
attributes.value: "select loan.id from Loan loan where loan.id BETWEEN :minLoanId and :maxLoanId and loan.loanStatus in :loanStatuses and :cobBusinessDate = loan.lastClosedBusinessDate"

attributes.name: FIND_ALL_LOAN_IDS_BY_STATUS
attributes.value: "SELECT loan.id FROM Loan loan WHERE loan.loanStatus = :loanStatus"

attributes.name: FIND_ALL_STAYED_LOCKED_BY_COB_BUSINESS_DATE
attributes.value: "select loan.id, loan.externalId, loan.accountNumber from LoanAccountLock lock left join Loan loan on lock.loanId = loan.id where lock.lockPlacedOnCobBusinessDate = :cobBusinessDate"

attributes.name: FIND_BY_ACCOUNT_NUMBER
attributes.value: "select loan from Loan loan where loan.accountNumber = :accountNumber"

attributes.name: FIND_CLIENT_LOANS_TO_UPDATE_LOANPRODUCT_COUNTER
attributes.value: "select l from Loan l where l.loanProductCounter > :loanProductCounter and l.client.id = :clientId and l.loanCounter is NULL order by l.loanProductCounter"

attributes.name: FIND_CLIENT_OR_JLG_LOANS_DISBURSED_AFTER
attributes.value: "select l from Loan l where (l.actualDisbursementDate IS NOT NULL and l.actualDisbursementDate > :disbursementDate) and l.client.id = :clientId order by l.actualDisbursementDate"

attributes.name: FIND_CLIENT_OR_JLG_LOANS_TO_UPDATE
attributes.value: "select l from Loan l where l.loanCounter > :loanCounter and l.client.id = :clientId order by l.loanCounter"

attributes.name: FIND_GROUP_LOANS_DISBURSED_AFTER
attributes.value: "select l from Loan l where ( l.actualDisbursementDate IS NOT NULL and l.actualDisbursementDate > :disbursementDate) and l.group.id = :groupId and l.loanType = :loanType order by l.actualDisbursementDate"

attributes.name: FIND_GROUP_LOANS_TO_UPDATE
attributes.value: "select l from Loan l where l.loanCounter > :loanCounter and l.group.id = :groupId and l.loanType = :groupLoanType order by l.loanCounter"

attributes.name: FIND_GROUP_LOANS_TO_UPDATE_LOANPRODUCT_COUNTER
attributes.value: "select l from Loan l where l.loanProductCounter > :loanProductCounter and l.group.id = :groupId and l.loanType = :groupLoanType and l.loanCounter is NULL order by l.loanProductCounter"

attributes.name: FIND_IDS_BY_EXTERNAL_IDS
attributes.value: "SELECT loan.id FROM Loan loan WHERE loan.externalId IN :externalIds ORDER BY loan.id ASC"

attributes.name: FIND_ID_BY_EXTERNAL_ID
attributes.value: "SELECT loan.id FROM Loan loan WHERE loan.externalId = :externalId"

attributes.name: FIND_LOANS_BY_ACCOUNT_NUMBER_AND_STATUSES
attributes.value: "select loan from Loan loan where loan.accountNumber = :accountNumber and loan.loanStatus in :loanStatuses"

attributes.name: FIND_LOANS_FOR_ADD_ACCRUAL
attributes.value: "select l from Loan l left join l.loanInterestRecalculationDetails recalcDetails where l.loanStatus = :loanStatus and l.isNpa = false and l.chargedOff = false and l.loanProduct.accountingRule = :accountingType and (recalcDetails.isCompoundingToBePostedAsTransaction is null or recalcDetails.isCompoundingToBePostedAsTransaction = false) and (exists (select ls.id from LoanRepaymentScheduleInstallment ls where ls.loan.id = l.id and ls.isDownPayment = false and ((coalesce(ls.interestCharged, 0) - coalesce(ls.interestWaived, 0)) <> coalesce(ls.interestAccrued, 0) or (coalesce(ls.feeChargesCharged, 0) - coalesce(ls.feeChargesWaived, 0)) <> coalesce(ls.feeAccrued, 0) or (coalesce(ls.penaltyCharges, 0) - coalesce(ls.penaltyChargesWaived, 0)) <> coalesce(ls.penaltyAccrued, 0)) and (:futureCharges = true or ls.dueDate <= :tillDate)))"

attributes.name: FIND_LOANS_FOR_PERIODIC_ACCRUAL
attributes.value: "select l from Loan l left join l.loanInterestRecalculationDetails recalcDetails where l.loanStatus = :loanStatus and l.isNpa = false and l.chargedOff = false and l.loanProduct.accountingRule = :accountingType and (recalcDetails.isCompoundingToBePostedAsTransaction is null or recalcDetails.isCompoundingToBePostedAsTransaction = false) and (exists (select ls.id from LoanRepaymentScheduleInstallment ls where ls.loan.id = l.id and ls.isDownPayment = false and ((coalesce(ls.interestCharged, 0) - coalesce(ls.interestWaived, 0)) <> coalesce(ls.interestAccrued, 0) or (coalesce(ls.feeChargesCharged, 0) - coalesce(ls.feeChargesWaived, 0)) <> coalesce(ls.feeAccrued, 0) or (coalesce(ls.penaltyCharges, 0) - coalesce(ls.penaltyChargesWaived, 0)) <> coalesce(ls.penaltyAccrued, 0)) and (:futureCharges = true or ls.fromDate < :tillDate or (ls.installmentNumber = (select min(lsi.installmentNumber) from LoanRepaymentScheduleInstallment lsi where lsi.loan.id = l.id and lsi.isDownPayment = false) and ls.fromDate = :tillDate))))"

attributes.name: FIND_LOAN_BY_CLIENT_AND_STATUS
attributes.value: "select loan from Loan loan where loan.id = :loanId and loan.loanStatus = :loanStatus and loan.client.id = :clientId"

attributes.name: FIND_LOAN_BY_EXTERNAL_ID
attributes.value: "SELECT loan FROM Loan loan WHERE loan.externalId = :externalId"

attributes.name: FIND_LOAN_DATA_FOR_EXTERNAL_TRANSFER
attributes.value: "select new org.apache.fineract.cob.data.LoanDataForExternalTransfer(loan.id, loan.externalId, loan.loanStatus, loan.loanProduct.id, loan.loanProduct.shortName) from Loan loan where loan.id = :loanId"

attributes.name: FIND_MAX_CLIENT_OR_JLG_LOAN_COUNTER_QUERY
attributes.value: "Select MAX(l.loanCounter) from Loan l where l.client.id = :clientId"

attributes.name: FIND_MAX_CLIENT_OR_JLG_LOAN_PRODUCT_COUNTER_QUERY
attributes.value: "Select MAX(l.loanProductCounter) from Loan l where l.client.id = :clientId and l.loanProduct.id = :productId"

attributes.name: FIND_MAX_GROUP_LOAN_COUNTER_QUERY
attributes.value: "Select MAX(l.loanCounter) from Loan l where l.group.id = :groupId and l.loanType = :loanType"

attributes.name: FIND_MAX_GROUP_LOAN_PRODUCT_COUNTER_QUERY
attributes.value: "Select MAX(l.loanProductCounter) from Loan l where l.group.id = :groupId and l.loanType = :loanType and l.loanProduct.id = :productId"

attributes.name: FIND_OLDEST_COB_PROCESSED_LOAN
attributes.value: "select loan.id, loan.lastClosedBusinessDate from Loan loan where loan.loanStatus in :loanStatuses and loan.lastClosedBusinessDate = (select min(l.lastClosedBusinessDate) from Loan l where l.loanStatus in :loanStatuses and l.lastClosedBusinessDate < :cobBusinessDate)"

attributes.name: LOANS_FOR_ACCRUAL
attributes.value: "select l from Loan l left join l.loanInterestRecalculationDetails recalcDetails where l.loanStatus = :loanStatus and l.isNpa = false and l.chargedOff = false and l.loanProduct.accountingRule = :accountingType and (recalcDetails.isCompoundingToBePostedAsTransaction is null or recalcDetails.isCompoundingToBePostedAsTransaction = false) and (exists (select ls.id from LoanRepaymentScheduleInstallment ls where ls.loan.id = l.id and ls.isDownPayment = false and ((coalesce(ls.interestCharged, 0) - coalesce(ls.interestWaived, 0)) <> coalesce(ls.interestAccrued, 0) or (coalesce(ls.feeChargesCharged, 0) - coalesce(ls.feeChargesWaived, 0)) <> coalesce(ls.feeAccrued, 0) or (coalesce(ls.penaltyCharges, 0) - coalesce(ls.penaltyChargesWaived, 0)) <> coalesce(ls.penaltyAccrued, 0)) "
